facts.activity_file: assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant
facts.title: audit finding - assurance activity of material unwanted event control at K-7301

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on K-7301 and TT-7301 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant. K-7301 (vapour recovery compressor) is in service for loading vapour recovery. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 13 October 2025 a planned assurance activity of K-7301 and TT-7301 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip not effective.
